params.rule:
1. publication type: case report, review, trial;
2. title signatures (TITLE_SIGNATURES): review; case, family or sibling
   report; a single patient; database or biobank; screening or method title
   (sequencing, panel, NGS, molecular or genetic testing, screening other than
   newborn screening, mutation analysis, "for mutations in", variant
   prevalence or frequency, diagnostic yield, unsolved or suspected cases,
   prenatal diagnosis, "is a frequent cause"); carriers or penetrance;
   variant-level work (novel or new variants, reclassification, in silico,
   functional studies, copy number); treatment; biomarker; model organism;
   then a plural disease group ("disorders", "cardiomyopathies") with no gene
   symbol of the paper; then a title count below MIN_PER_UNIT;
3. abstract signatures (ABSTRACT_SIGNATURES, on title and abstract):
   diagnostic yield or negative-tested or unexplained cohorts; sequencing
   applied to a series of N; association or risk designs (susceptibility,
   predisposition, odds or hazard ratio, case-control, risk factors,
   polymorphism, comparison with healthy individuals); penetrance in carriers
   (unaffected carriers, cascade or family screening, lifetime risk, general
   population); variant databases or biobanks; then positives reported as a
   share of those screened, all below MIN_PER_UNIT;
4. positive evidence of a per-unit cohort of at least MIN_PER_UNIT: a stated
   count bound to a gene symbol of the paper or to a single disease (a defined
   abbreviation whose long form is not a plural group, or a disease noun), or a
   bare count in an abstract whose title names a single disease or gene and no
   group.

title_signatures.title:case_report: case report|\ba case of\b|\bcase series of (?:two|three)\b
title_signatures.title:screening_method: sequencing|\bpanels?\b|\bNGS\b|molecular (?:testing|diagnosis|screening)|genetic (?:testing|screening)|(?<!newborn )(?<!neonatal )screening|mutation(?:al)? analysis|\bfor (?:[\w-]+ ){0,2}(?:mutations|variants)\b|population-based|prevalence of (?:[\w-]+ ){0,4}(?:mutations|variants|deletions|duplications)|frequency of|diagnostic yield|diagnostic rate|detection rate|unsolved|suspicion|suspected|prenatal diagnosis|(?:is|are) (?:a )?(?:frequent|major|common|rare|significant) (?:[\w-]+ )?causes?

abstract_signatures.diagnostic_yield: diagnostic yield|diagnostic rate|detection rate|solve rate|molecular testing|diagnostic utility|\b(?:un)?solved\b|negative for|tested negative|previously (?:tested|unsolved|undiagnosed|unexplained)|genetically (?:unexplained|unresolved|undetermined|undiagnosed)|unknown (?:a?etiology|cause)
abstract_signatures.association: susceptib|predispos|odds ratio|case[- ]control|risk factors?|genetic risk|increased risk|risk alleles?|polymorphism|\bGWAS\b|genome-wide association|association (?:study|analysis)|hazard ratio|compared (?:with|to) (?:\d+ )?healthy

params.few_positives: \b([\w,]+) (?:[\w-]+ ){0,3}\(\s?\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s?%\)\s?(?:[\w-]+ ){0,2}(?:carried|harbou?red|had|tested positive|were positive|were found to (?:carry|harbou?r|have))|(?:identified|detected|found) in (?:[\w-]+ ){0,2}([\w,]+) (?:[\w-]+ ){0,3}\(\s?\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s?%\)|\b([\w,]+) (?:of|out of) (?:the )?[\d,]+ (?:[\w-]+ ){0,3}(?:carried|harbou?red|tested positive|were positive)
params.subset: selected papers of lit-sources-v1 that pass, minus the calibration shards' papers

notes: 305 of 999 re-screened papers pass; a subset of lit-sources-v1. Frozen before any further paper extraction (ADR-0013). The record cache holds abstracts; private release only.
